title: The Covenant Renewed on the Plains of Moab
description: Moses reminds Israel of the Lord's deeds in Egypt and the journey through the wilderness, gathering all the people—leaders, women, children, and foreigners—to renew their covenant oath with the Lord. This covenant also applies to future generations. Moses warns against idolatry, which will bring the Lord's anger, curses, and exile upon the land, just as happened to Sodom and Gomorrah.
